title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: introducing the new “Recent Record” virtual table
summary: Business Central 2026 Wave 2 introduces a new Recent Record virtual table that tracks records recently accessed by the current user in the current company. The read-only table logs only UI interactions and stores references to original records with timestamps, allowing users to clear their access history.
key_points: New Recent Record virtual table in the System.Environment namespace, added silently in 2026 Wave 2 (v29), lists records the current user recently accessed in the current company
Table is read-only (no insert or modify) but rows can be deleted to clear history; fields are TableId and RecordSystemId (primary key), LastUsed and Description
Only UI interactions are logged; records touched by code, such as reports or actions, are not recorded
Reopening a record already in the list refreshes its LastUsed value

quotes.text: This table (defined in the System.Environment namespace) lists the records most recently accessed by the current user in the current company.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the scope and location of the new virtual table for developers implementing user activity tracking.

quotes.text: Records on this table are not logged if a record is managed via code.
quotes.why_it_matters: Important limitation to understand when using the table for user monitoring, as only UI interactions are captured.
